mechanism_narrative: A sustained 20-day decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% in a single month triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative when UNRATE crosses 4.5% threshold (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both INDPRO (supply) and GDPC1 (demand) indices in the same month signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns when both proxies rise simultaneously (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: During a 'late-cycle expansion' regime, a 5% drop in HOUST (demand) over one month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns in the subsequent 60 trading days as investors anticipate cooling demand.
candidate_trigger: HOUST drops >5% in late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when HOUST drops >5% in designated regime (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 60-day sustained decline in the federal funds rate indicates prolonged monetary easing, which compresses discount rates and enhances equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not higher than baseline in 60% of cases (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (demand) indices in the same month strengthen economic momentum, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns when both demand proxies rise simultaneously (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (labor) above 100,000 workers signals labor market strain, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate hiring.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative when PAYEMS crosses 100k threshold (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a 'monetary tightening cycle', a 3% drop in HOUST (demand) over one month predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns in the next 20 trading days due to heightened inflation concerns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST drops >3% in tightening cycle regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative when HOUST drops >3% in designated regime (p > 0.05).
